title: 河川水位自動遙測~Automatic river-level telemetry
focus: 把水位感測、時間與發布品質連成可追溯資料鏈~Connecting stage sensing, timing and publication quality into a traceable chain
summary: 本課將自動水位站拆為基準、感測、取樣、傳輸、率定與電源備援，逐一區分準確度、資料時效及可用性。以李斯渡口和維克斯堡真實站點為背景，所有算例是合成資料；觀測水位、推估流量和警戒決策屬不同層次，必須保留各自假設及品質旗標。~This course separates automated gaging into datum, sensing, sampling, transmission, rating and power redundancy, distinguishing accuracy, data age and availability. Lees Ferry and Vicksburg provide real station context, while every calculation uses synthetic observations. Measured stage, estimated discharge and warning decisions occupy different layers and require their own assumptions and quality flags.

units.anchor: 測站基準與水面高程~Gage datum and water elevation
units.title: 測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證~Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 水位計讀值通常相對測站自訂零點，不等於海拔或工程共用高程。基準點沉陷、支架位移與換儀器可能使整段資料產生偏移，即使曲線仍然平滑；跨站或與堤頂比較前必須連接相同垂直基準，並保存基準更動日期，避免把儀器零點變化誤認為河川水位突變。本例基準與讀值已用同一垂直系統及公尺表示；沒有處理不同國家高程系統、橢球高或潮位基準間的轉換。~A gage reading is generally relative to a station datum rather than sea level or a shared project elevation. Benchmark settlement, support movement and instrument replacement can shift an entire record while leaving a smooth curve. Comparing stations or levee crests requires a common vertical datum and documented changes so that instrument offsets are not mistaken for river-level changes. The example uses meters and one vertical system for datum and reading. It does not convert national height systems, ellipsoidal heights or tidal datums.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設測站零點高程z0=100.00 m、水尺讀值h=2.35 m，水面高程Z=z0+h=102.35 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gage-datum elevation z0=100.00 m and reading h=2.35 m. Water-surface elevation Z=z0+h=102.35 m.
units.verify: 由獨立穩定基準點檢查水尺及感測器標高，保留水準閉合與前後儀器高度。對任何零點改正加上生效日期和版本，並用同時人工讀值確認自動資料沒有未標記跳變。~Check staff-gage and sensor elevations from independent stable marks, retaining leveling closure and instrument-height records. Date and version every datum correction, and compare simultaneous manual observations to ensure that automated data contain no unmarked discontinuity after installation or adjustment.
units.failure: 把局部水尺數字直接和海拔堤頂比較會產生錯誤餘高，支架沉陷又可能讓整季記錄偏移；若改正覆蓋原資料，事後便無法追溯當時顯示的警戒情境。~Comparing a local gage number directly with a levee elevation gives false freeboard, and support settlement can bias a season of data. Overwriting originals with corrections prevents reconstruction of the warning information displayed at the time.
units.misconception: 所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。~Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum.
units.practice: 為兩站建立零點、讀值和水面高程表，讓一站零點改變但實際水面不變。說明資料庫應如何保留原值、改正值及版本，以免形成假洪峰。~Build datum, reading and elevation tables for two stations, changing one datum without changing the physical surface. Explain how original values, corrections and versions should be retained to prevent an artificial flood peak.

units.anchor: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償~Pressure sensing and barometric compensation
units.title: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證~Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 浸水式壓力計依水柱壓力換算深度，絕對壓力感測器需扣除同步大氣壓，通氣式則依通氣管維持參考。水密度受溫鹽影響，感測器位置也可能被淤埋或漂移；因此壓力變化不一定全是水位變化，氣壓補償和安裝高程必須與原始壓力一起保存。本例使用已扣氣壓的表壓並假設靜水、淡水定密度；在高速流或堵塞導壓管附近，動壓與延遲需要另行評估。~A submerged pressure sensor converts water-column pressure to depth. Absolute sensors require synchronized atmospheric subtraction, while vented sensors rely on a reference vent. Density varies with temperature and salinity, and the sensor can be buried or displaced. Pressure changes therefore need not all represent stage changes; barometric compensation and installation elevation must accompany the raw pressure record. The example uses gauge pressure after atmospheric subtraction and assumes hydrostatic freshwater of fixed density. Dynamic pressure and lag require separate assessment near fast flow or blocked pressure tubing.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Water-column height h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m.
units.verify: 同步記錄水壓與氣壓，核對壓力種類、單位與感測器標高，並以人工水尺交叉比較。檢查通氣管結露、導壓管堵塞與漂移，避免用軟體校正常數掩蓋實際安裝故障。~Record water and atmospheric pressure synchronously, checking pressure type, units and sensor elevation against a manual staff gage. Inspect vent condensation, pressure-line blockage and displacement so that software correction constants do not conceal physical installation faults or delayed response.
units.failure: 將絕對壓力直接換成水深會把大氣壓算入水柱，通氣管受潮則可能形成緩慢偏差；淤埋造成的遲滯也可能讓洪峰看起來較低且較晚。~Converting absolute pressure directly includes atmospheric pressure as water depth. A wet vent can produce gradual bias, while sediment burial may delay response and make a flood crest appear lower and later.
units.misconception: 任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。~Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth.
units.practice: 比較相同水位下兩種大氣壓的絕對壓力讀值，完成扣除後確認水深不變。再加入氣壓資料延遲情境，說明時間同步和精確感測同樣必要。~Compare absolute readings at two atmospheric pressures with unchanged water level and confirm invariant depth after subtraction. Then introduce delayed barometric data and explain why synchronization matters alongside sensor precision.

units.anchor: 雷達距離與安裝幾何~Radar range and installation geometry
units.title: 雷達距離與安裝幾何機理與驗證~Radar range and installation geometry mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 非接觸雷達由天線到水面的傳播訊號求距離，再與天線高程組合成水面高程。量到的是距離而不是直接水位，斜裝、波浪、橋構件與漂浮物可能改變有效回波；儀器內部常使用調頻等處理，但基礎往返傳播關係仍可用來核對量綱與幾何方向。本例為理想垂直往返飛行時間示意，近似空氣中光速；不是描述特定雷達的電子取樣解析度或實際量測準確度。~Noncontact radar derives antenna-to-surface range from the propagation signal and combines it with antenna elevation. It measures distance rather than stage directly; tilt, waves, bridge members and floating debris can change the effective return. Practical instruments often use frequency-modulated processing, but the basic round-trip relation remains useful for checking dimensions and geometric direction. The example illustrates ideal vertical round-trip travel time using approximate light speed in air. It does not describe a particular radar’s sampling resolution or field accuracy.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設c=3.0×10⁸ m/s、往返t=40 ns，距離d=ct/2=6.00 m；天線Zs=110 m時水面Z=104 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume c=3.0×10⁸ m/s and round-trip t=40 ns. Range d=ct/2=6.00 m; antenna elevation Zs=110 m gives water elevation Z=104 m.
units.verify: 量測天線標高與傾角並檢查波束覆蓋，將回波品質和水尺讀值同步保存。針對橋面反射、漂浮物及暴雨測試異常旗標，確認失去有效水面回波時不會輸出看似正常的舊值。~Survey antenna elevation and tilt, inspect beam coverage and retain echo-quality indicators with simultaneous staff-gage readings. Test anomaly flags for bridge reflections, floating objects and intense rain, ensuring that lost water-surface returns do not silently appear as normal stale measurements.
units.failure: 漏除往返因子二會把距離加倍，天線支架位移則使所有高程產生偏移；挑錯回波可能讀到橋梁或漂流物，曲線平滑也不能保證目標正確。~Omitting the round-trip factor doubles range, and support movement shifts all elevations. Selecting the wrong return may track a bridge or floating debris; a smooth time series does not guarantee the correct target.
units.misconception: 雷達不接觸水，所以不需要高程測量或現地水尺交叉驗證。~Noncontact radar needs neither elevation surveying nor field staff-gage checks.
units.practice: 畫出天線、橋構件及水面三個回波路徑，指出哪條距離可用於水面高程。改變天線標高並保持水面不變，說明資料系統必須同步更新哪些參數。~Draw antenna, bridge-member and water-surface return paths, identifying the range usable for elevation. Change antenna height without moving the water and explain which data-system parameters must be updated together.

units.anchor: 取樣間隔與漏失洪峰~Sampling interval and missed crests
units.title: 取樣間隔與漏失洪峰機理與驗證~Sampling interval and missed crests mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 離散水位資料只能觀察取樣時刻，洪峰若發生在兩筆之間就可能被低估。提高取樣頻率可縮小這類誤差，但儲存、傳輸頻率與畫面更新不一定相同；平均濾波又可能壓低短時尖峰，因此應保存原始取樣時間，並區分缺測與真正平穩水位。下式假設內部洪峰附近水位變化速率有已知上限且兩側取樣完整；只界定時間離散誤差，未含儀器誤差或資料中斷。~Discrete records observe stage only at sample times, so a crest between samples can be underestimated. Faster sampling reduces this error, but storage, transmission and display frequencies need not match. Averaging can additionally suppress short peaks, making original timestamps and a clear distinction between missing data and genuinely stable stage essential. The bound assumes a known maximum rate around an interior crest and complete samples on both sides. It concerns temporal discretization only, excluding sensor error and missing records.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設|dh/dt|≤r=0.004 m/s、等距取樣Δt=60 s，洪峰到最近取樣最多30 s，漏峰界限rΔt/2=0.12 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume |dh/dt|≤r=0.004 m/s and sample interval Δt=60 s. The nearest sample is at most 30 s away, giving missed-crest bound rΔt/2=0.12 m.
units.verify: 從原始時間戳檢查實際取樣間距及遺漏，將平均後曲線與高頻原資料比較。以獨立事件驗證速率上限的合理性；若有缺筆或未觀測尖峰，需撤回此完整取樣誤差界限。~Check actual intervals and omissions from original timestamps, comparing averaged curves with high-frequency records. Assess the assumed rate bound against independent events; if samples are missing or sharper behavior is unobserved, withdraw this complete-sampling error bound instead of treating it as guaranteed.
units.failure: 把傳輸每小時一次誤當成現地每分鐘取樣會低估資訊延遲，平均值也可能掩蓋警戒尖峰；無資料時延用最後值會產生看似平穩的假象。~Confusing hourly transmission with minute-by-minute local sampling understates information delay, and averaging can conceal a warning crest. Repeating the last value during an outage creates the false appearance of stable water level.
units.misconception: 只要圖表每秒重畫，就代表河川每秒都有一筆新量測。~A graph refreshed every second means the river has a new measurement every second.
units.practice: 建立一個落在兩取樣點中間的三角洪峰，分別以六十秒和三十秒取樣比較峰值。將顯示更新頻率保持相同，說明它為何不會補回漏掉的觀測。~Create a triangular crest between samples and compare sixty- and thirty-second sampling. Keep display refresh unchanged and explain why faster redraws do not recover observations that were never collected.

units.anchor: 傳輸延遲與資料時效~Transmission latency and data age
units.title: 傳輸延遲與資料時效機理與驗證~Transmission latency and data age mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 自動遙測鏈包含感測、記錄、通訊、接收與發布，各段延遲相加才形成使用者看到的資料年齡。接收時間不等於量測時間，補傳舊封包更可能讓新到資料看似最新水位；洪水快速上升時，即使數值本身準確，過時資料仍可能造成錯誤情境判讀。本例在固定上升速率下比較量測時與現在的差異，不是預報模型；真實加速度、回落及通訊中斷會破壞線性外推。~An automated chain includes sensing, logging, communication, reception and publication; their delays determine the age of displayed information. Receipt time is not observation time, and retransmitted old packets can look deceptively current. During a rapid rise, an accurate but stale reading can still produce a misleading picture of the river. The example compares observation time with the present under a constant rise rate. It is not a forecast model; acceleration, recession and communication outages invalidate simple linear extrapolation.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水位上升率r=0.003 m/s、總資料延遲L=120 s，線性時效差Δh=rL=0.36 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume rise rate r=0.003 m/s and total data latency L=120 s. Linear age-related difference Δh=rL=0.36 m.
units.verify: 保存量測、封包發送、接收與發布四種時間，使用一致時區和校時紀錄。透過測試封包量測端到端延遲分布，對補傳和過期資料加註旗標，避免只報平均延遲而漏掉長尾。~Retain observation, transmission, receipt and publication times with consistent timezone and clock records. Measure end-to-end latency distributions using test packets, flag backfilled and stale data, and inspect long delays rather than reporting only an average that hides the tail.
units.failure: 用收到封包的時間覆蓋量測時間會把歷史水位當現況，時區錯置也可能產生假負延遲；只用平均通訊速度無法描述暴雨時的最長資料空窗。~Replacing observation time with receipt time presents historical stage as current, while timezone mistakes can create impossible negative latency. Average communication speed does not describe the longest information gaps during a storm.
units.misconception: 封包剛收到就一定代表此刻水位，無需再看量測時間。~A newly received packet necessarily represents current stage without checking observation time.
units.practice: 畫出含一次補傳的時間線，分開標記觀測與發布順序。計算每筆資料年齡並制定畫面標示規則，說明哪些值只能補歷史而不能覆蓋最新狀態。~Draw a timeline containing a retransmission, separating observation order from publication order. Calculate each record’s age and define display labels, explaining which records may fill history but must not replace the latest state.

units.anchor: 水位流量關係與外推~Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation
units.title: 水位流量關係與外推機理與驗證~Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 河川水位轉成流量通常依現地率定關係，控制斷面、糙率及回水變化會讓同一水位對應不同流量。漲退水遲滯與下游潮位可能使單值曲線失效；因此水位遙測完成不代表流量已直接量到，率定版本、有效範圍與量測支撐必須隨資料一起提供。本例採指定單值冪次曲線並明列係數單位，限定有效水頭為正；不是實站率定，也不應外推到回水或河床劇變情境。~Converting stage to discharge normally uses a site-calibrated relation whose behavior depends on channel control, roughness and backwater. Rising/falling hysteresis and downstream tide can give different flows at the same stage. Automated stage measurement therefore does not mean discharge was directly measured; rating version, valid range and supporting observations must accompany derived flow. The example specifies a single-valued power rating with coefficient units and positive effective head. It is not a real station rating and should not be extrapolated into backwater or major bed change.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=a(h−h0)^b，a=20 m^1.4/s、b=1.6、h=2.0 m、h0=0.5 m，Q=38.26 m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=a(h−h0)^b, a=20 m^1.4/s, b=1.6, h=2.0 m and h0=0.5 m. Discharge Q=38.26 m³/s.
units.verify: 以獨立流量量測覆蓋漲退水及不同水位，檢查殘差是否與下游水位或時間有系統關係。保存率定版本和外推旗標，洪水後重新查控制斷面，而不是只調係數追求漂亮擬合。~Use independent discharge measurements across stages and both hydrograph limbs, checking whether residuals depend systematically on downstream level or time. Retain rating versions and extrapolation flags, and resurvey channel control after floods instead of merely adjusting coefficients for an attractive fit.
units.failure: 把超出量測範圍的曲線延伸當實測會低估高水位不確定度，河床沖淤後沿用舊率定也可能產生系統偏差；單點水位無法唯一解決強回水流量。~Calling an extrapolated curve measured flow understates high-stage uncertainty, and using an old rating after bed change introduces bias. One stage observation cannot uniquely resolve discharge under strong backwater.
units.misconception: 裝好水位計後，任何洪水流量都能無誤差地自動換算。~Once a stage sensor is installed, every flood discharge converts automatically without error.
units.practice: 用指定曲線計算兩個水位，標出有效水頭與係數單位。再畫出相同水位有兩個流量的遲滯示意，說明需要增加哪種觀測才能區分兩支曲線。~Calculate two discharges from the specified rating, labeling effective head and coefficient units. Draw a hysteresis example with two flows at one stage and explain what additional observation could distinguish the two branches.

units.anchor: 上升速率與雜訊~Rise-rate estimation and noise
units.title: 上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證~Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 水位上升速率能補充絕對水位資訊，但差分運算會放大量測雜訊和時間誤差。取樣間隔越短，並不保證速率越準確；過度平滑雖降低雜訊卻延遲急升訊號，因此應將原始資料、濾波方式和速率計算窗分開保存，避免用單一尖峰差分觸發無法解釋的判斷。本例計算兩筆有效讀值間的平均變化率，不代表區間內瞬時最大值；警戒規則與多源確認需另按實際防洪系統制定。~Rise rate supplements absolute stage, but differencing amplifies measurement noise and timing errors. A shorter interval does not guarantee a more accurate derivative. Heavy smoothing reduces noise while delaying rapid-rise signals, so raw data, filtering method and derivative window should remain separately documented rather than relying on an unexplained single-sample spike. The example is the mean rate between two valid readings, not the maximum instantaneous rate within the interval. Warning rules and multisource confirmation require a separate operational framework.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水位由2.10升至2.22 m、間隔Δt=600 s，平均r=0.12/600=0.00020 m/s=0.72 m/h。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume stage rises from 2.10 to 2.22 m over Δt=600 s. Mean r=0.12/600=0.00020 m/s=0.72 m/h.
units.verify: 檢查兩筆資料的品質旗標、實際時間差及是否跨越零點改正，再比較不同窗長的速率。用已知事件或合成訊號量測濾波延遲，將可接受雜訊與漏失急升的取捨明確記錄。~Check quality flags, actual time separation and any intervening datum correction, then compare rates from different windows. Measure filter delay with known events or synthetic signals, explicitly recording the tradeoff between tolerated noise and missed or delayed rapid rises.
units.failure: 兩個相鄰讀值的小誤差經短時間差相除可變成巨大速率，跨越零點調整也會形成假急升；過度濾波則可能把真實快速上漲延後呈現。~Small adjacent-reading errors divided by a short interval can create a large apparent rate, and a datum adjustment can mimic a surge. Excessive filtering can instead display a genuine rapid rise too late.
units.misconception: 取樣越密，任何相鄰兩點差分得到的水位速率就一定越可靠。~Denser sampling always makes a two-point stage derivative more reliable.
units.practice: 給兩筆水位加入正負一公分誤差，比較短窗和長窗的速率偏差。另以快速上升訊號測試移動平均，說明減噪與延遲不能只用同一個指標評分。~Add opposite one-centimeter errors to two readings and compare rate bias over short and long windows. Test a moving average on a rapid rise and explain why noise reduction and delay need separate evaluation metrics.

units.anchor: 高程不確定度合成~Elevation uncertainty combination
units.title: 高程不確定度合成機理與驗證~Elevation uncertainty combination mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 自動水位高程包含感測、基準連接和安裝幾何等不確定度，顯示小數位數不代表同樣程度的可信度。獨立隨機項可用平方和合成，但共同基準偏差、漂移及未修正系統誤差不能隨意當成獨立量；報告需區分標準不確定度、擴展區間與誤差來源，而不是只給一個精度標籤。下式只合成兩個指定獨立標準不確定度，沒有乘涵蓋因子；不能把結果直接稱為百分之九十五信賴區間或量測閉合差。~Automated elevation combines sensor, datum-transfer and installation-geometry uncertainty, and display decimals do not imply equal confidence. Independent random contributions can be combined by root-sum-square, but shared datum bias, drift and uncorrected systematic error cannot simply be treated as independent. Reports should distinguish standard uncertainty, expanded intervals and contributing sources rather than provide one vague accuracy label. The expression combines two specified independent standard uncertainties without a coverage factor. It is neither automatically a 95-percent interval nor a measured leveling closure error.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設感測標準不確定度us=0.010 m、基準連接ud=0.020 m且獨立，uc=√(us²+ud²)=0.02236 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent sensor uncertainty us=0.010 m and datum-transfer uncertainty ud=0.020 m. Combined standard uc=√(us²+ud²)=0.02236 m.
units.verify: 建立誤差來源表，列明每項來自校正、重複量測或幾何估計，以及是否共享參考。檢查偏差是否已改正，將標準不確定度和實際水準閉合值分開，必要時保留相關係數再合成。~Build a source table identifying calibration, repeat measurement or geometric estimation and shared references. Check whether bias has been corrected, keep standard uncertainty distinct from actual leveling closure, and retain covariance terms where dependence prevents a simple independent combination.
units.failure: 把共同基準誤差當兩個獨立項可能錯估比較結果，增加取樣也無法消除固定偏差；將平方和結果直接標為最大誤差則又混淆機率尺度與保證界限。~Treating shared datum error as independent can misstate a comparison, and more samples do not remove fixed bias. Labeling a root-sum-square result as maximum error further confuses a probabilistic scale with a guaranteed bound.
units.misconception: 感測器顯示到毫米，就代表水面絕對高程也準確到毫米。~Millimeter display resolution means absolute water elevation is accurate to a millimeter.
units.practice: 將一份誤差表分成獨立與共用來源，先合成可獨立的項，再討論共用基準如何影響兩站高差。寫出包含單位和涵蓋說明的完整結果句。~Separate independent and shared sources, combine only eligible terms, then discuss how a shared datum affects a two-station elevation difference. Write a complete result sentence with units and an explicit statement about coverage.

units.anchor: 備援電源與能量帳~Backup power and energy budget
units.title: 備援電源與能量帳機理與驗證~Backup power and energy budget mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 偏遠測站的可用時間取決於平均負載、通訊脈衝、電池可用容量及環境條件，不能只看安培小時數。電壓換算、允許放電深度和電源轉換損失都影響可用能量，低溫與老化又可能降低容量；太陽能日均供電也無法單獨保證連續陰雨期間仍有資料。本例以固定平均負載與指定可用係數作能量比較，忽略自放電、老化和低溫；計算時數不是實站續航保證。~Remote-station endurance depends on average load, transmission pulses, usable battery capacity and environment rather than ampere-hours alone. Voltage, allowed depth of discharge and conversion losses determine useful energy, while cold and aging may reduce capacity. Mean solar input likewise cannot guarantee observations throughout an extended cloudy period. The example uses fixed mean load and specified usable factors, excluding self-discharge, aging and cold. Calculated hours are an energy comparison, not a station-endurance guarantee.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設電池12 V、40 Ah、可用放電比例0.50、轉換效率0.85、平均負載2 W，續航t=12×40×0.50×0.85/2=102 h。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume battery 12 V, 40 Ah, usable discharge fraction 0.50, conversion efficiency 0.85 and mean load 2 W. Endurance t=12×40×0.50×0.85/2=102 h.
units.verify: 量測感測、待機和傳輸各狀態功率及占空比，將短時峰值和平均能量分開核對。以老化與低溫容量資料更新可用量，並用中斷充電的測試確認低電量標示及資料保存行為。~Measure sensing, standby and transmission power with duty cycles, checking peak demand separately from average energy. Update usable capacity with aging and temperature evidence, and test interrupted charging to confirm low-battery indication and preservation of observations before power is exhausted.
units.failure: 忽略傳輸峰值可能使電池尚有能量卻因瞬時壓降重啟，使用新電池容量估計老站又會高估續航；斷電後無明確旗標可能被誤解為河水停止變化。~Ignoring transmission peaks can cause reset from voltage sag despite remaining energy. Using new-battery capacity for an aged station overstates endurance, and missing outage flags can make power failure look like unchanging river stage.
units.misconception: 電池安培小時越大就可直接比較續航，不需要知道電壓或負載。~Battery ampere-hours alone compare endurance without voltage or load information.
units.practice: 將通訊占空比增加一倍後重算平均負載，再比較低溫容量下降情境。為能量耗盡前後設計資料旗標，區分感測中斷、通訊中斷和仍可本地記錄的狀態。~Double communication duty cycle and recalculate mean load, then compare reduced cold-weather capacity. Define data flags around energy exhaustion that distinguish sensing failure, communication loss and continued local recording.

units.anchor: 獨立備援與共因失效~Independent redundancy and common causes
units.title: 獨立備援與共因失效機理與驗證~Independent redundancy and common causes mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 兩套感測或通訊可提高資料可用性，但只有真正獨立的失效才可直接相乘。若共用電源、支架、基準點或被同一洪水淹沒，備援仍可能同時失效；不同技術也可能共享資料伺服器，應沿整條量測到發布路徑辨認共因，而不是只數現場儀器數量。本例定義相同觀察期間兩通道失效機率且假設獨立，只示範理想備援；未加入修復、共因及不同失效模式。~Two sensors or links can improve availability, but failure probabilities multiply only for independent events. Shared power, support, datum or flood exposure can disable both. Different sensing technologies may still share a publication server, so common causes must be traced through the complete observation-to-display chain rather than inferred from device count. The example defines channel-failure probabilities over the same observation period and assumes independence. It illustrates ideal redundancy without repair, common causes or multiple failure modes.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩通道期間失效機率p1=p2=0.02且獨立，同時失效p=p1p2=0.0004，即0.04%。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent channel-failure probabilities p1=p2=0.02 over the same period. Joint failure p=p1p2=0.0004, or 0.04%.
units.verify: 畫出感測、電源、通訊與發布的依賴圖，逐項尋找共用構件和洪水暴露。以受控故障測試確認切換、補傳與資料旗標，並用實際事件記錄評估獨立假設是否成立。~Map dependencies among sensing, power, communication and publication, identifying shared components and flood exposure. Use controlled failure tests to check switching, backfill and quality flags, then examine event records to assess whether the assumed independence is supported rather than merely convenient.
units.failure: 共用電源的雙感測器可能一次斷電全部停擺，雙通訊也可能同時依賴同一伺服器；直接乘機率會給出過度樂觀的可用性，卻沒有增加真正的失效隔離。~Two sensors on one supply can fail in a single outage, and two links may depend on the same server. Multiplying probabilities then gives optimistic availability without genuine isolation of the failure mechanisms.
units.misconception: 只要現場裝兩支感測器，就一定可以把全部失效機率相乘。~Installing two field sensors always permits multiplication of all failure probabilities.
units.practice: 為雙感測器畫出共用與獨立電源兩個架構，指出哪些故障可由另一通道保留觀測。加入共同淹水事件後重新描述模型限制，避免把理想數字當保證。~Draw shared- and independent-power versions of a dual-sensor system, identifying failures that leave observations available. Add a common inundation event and restate the model limits rather than presenting the ideal probability as a guarantee.

example: 敏感度固定率定係數a=20 m^1.4/s與指數b=1.6，原水位h=2.0 m、零流量參數h0=0.5 m，流量為38.26 m³/s。若水位有正偏差0.10 m而其他參數不變，有效水頭由1.5增至1.6 m，推估流量變成42.43 m³/s，增加約10.88%。這不是把水位增加5%就讓流量增加5%，因率定依有效水頭的非線性冪次變化。實際站點還可能有回水、控制改變及率定參數不確定度；本例只隔離水位偏差，不能據此宣稱流量總誤差或設置警戒值。~Hold rating coefficient a=20 m^1.4/s and exponent b=1.6 fixed, with h=2.0 m and zero-flow parameter h0=0.5 m. The baseline estimate is 38.26 m³/s. A positive stage bias of 0.10 m raises effective head from 1.5 to 1.6 m and gives 42.43 m³/s, approximately 10.88% higher. A five-percent increase in the displayed stage therefore does not produce a five-percent discharge change, because the relation is nonlinear in effective head. Real stations additionally face backwater, control changes and uncertain rating parameters. This isolates stage bias only and establishes neither total discharge error nor a warning setting. Datum checks and independent discharge measurements remain separate evidence needed to evaluate the resulting record.
history: 維克斯堡站歷史資料記載1977年起的橋下游觀測位置，並說明不同位置即使共用基準仍受水面坡度影響。美國地質調查局於2010年發布水位量測和測站水準測量方法，強調感測與基準維護需並行。李斯渡口官方站頁提供站號、連續資料及明確水位高程換算背景。NOAA的資料收集系統則展示現地平台、衛星與發布鏈的架構。本課於2026年核對這些公開資料，不推定列名測站使用任何特定電池或假設備援配置。~Vicksburg’s historical record documents the downstream-bridge observation location from 1977 and notes that water-surface slope affects readings even under a shared datum. USGS published stage-measurement and gaging-station leveling methods in 2010, linking sensing with datum maintenance. The official Lees Ferry page supplies its identifier, continuous-data context and explicit elevation conversion. NOAA’s Data Collection System illustrates platform, satellite and distribution architecture. These public materials were checked in 2026; no particular battery or hypothetical redundancy arrangement is attributed to either station.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Water-column height h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設c=3.0×10⁸ m/s、往返t=40 ns，距離d=ct/2=6.00 m；天線Zs=110 m時水面Z=104 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume c=3.0×10⁸ m/s and round-trip t=40 ns. Range d=ct/2=6.00 m; antenna elevation Zs=110 m gives water elevation Z=104 m.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設|dh/dt|≤r=0.004 m/s、等距取樣Δt=60 s，洪峰到最近取樣最多30 s，漏峰界限rΔt/2=0.12 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume |dh/dt|≤r=0.004 m/s and sample interval Δt=60 s. The nearest sample is at most 30 s away, giving missed-crest bound rΔt/2=0.12 m.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水位上升率r=0.003 m/s、總資料延遲L=120 s，線性時效差Δh=rL=0.36 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume rise rate r=0.003 m/s and total data latency L=120 s. Linear age-related difference Δh=rL=0.36 m.
